topic: Finite-array cross-arm collision frontier for covariate-assisted optimal-transport bounds. In two independent arms, observe binary outcomes on K uniform covariate cells with known amplitudes 0<b<a<1/2 and deterministic sign arrays; target the actual sharp binary-cost COT endpoint L_K=a-b rho_K. When lambda=n_0 n_1/K has a finite limit and triple collisions vanish, prove marked-Poisson equivalence under supported product mixtures and uniform collision-statistic approximation over deterministic arrays. Derive certified finite interval-action LPs for exact minimax absolute risk and uniformly honest expected interval length, and prove two-sided honest-minimax transfer to the full deterministic-array experiment. When lambda diverges sparsely, prove unprojected studentized Gaussian inference centered at L_K with the matching interior local minimax variance. Transfer only to the declared continuous growing-roughness interpolation image. Consumer: causalPIviaCOT partition-resolution diagnostics; coarsening changes the endpoint absent a separate bias bound. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Parameter-free reverse kernels, deterministic collision bounds, interval expansion and coverage repair were derived; exact checks give zero-collision risk b/2 and honest length (1-alpha)b, one-mark honest length 0.09489725068496811, and R(0.025)=0.049950617272262944 for a=.2,b=.1,r=.5. Six LP refinements at lambda=.025,1,10 produced contracting floating-point brackets with explicit off-grid repairs. A former fixed-array witness was rejected because marginal imbalance leaked information; supported mixtures over legal arrays repair the lower experiment without changing the target. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Complete the LAN-to-deterministic-shell local minimax theorem for bounded truncated quadratic losses, explicitly ordering local-radius and loss-truncation limits, and package rigorous interval-LP enclosures. EARLY KILL TEST: At lambda=1, double interval-action resolution and rigorously enclose primal/dual values and every coverage segment; require a shrinking certified bracket with coverage at least .95, using the exact one-mark value as an independent control. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/pid_cot_collision_frontier.md.

open_problems.open_problem: When lambda_K=n_0n_1/K diverges while triple collisions remain negligible, prove a uniform studentized Gaussian limit for the unprojected collision estimator centered at L_K and show that its variance equals the interior local asymptotic minimax variance over deterministic Hamming shells.

source_refs.claim: A COT stability argument yields asymptotic normality under smooth densities for quadratic cost, leaving nonsmooth binary costs and sparse growing partitions outside its theorem.
source_refs.author: Sirui Lin, Zijun Gao, Jose Blanchet, Peter Glynn

source_refs.claim: Large-alphabet Poisson testing has a collision-dominated small-count regime and admits sharp constant-level minimax analysis in denser regimes.
source_refs.author: Alon Kipnis

source_refs.claim: A conditional CLT under a Poisson mixture prior transfers a sharp minimax lower bound to a fixed-size multinomial experiment.
source_refs.author: Alon Kipnis

source_refs.claim: Limits-of-experiments methods identify local asymptotic minimax procedures in nonregular models where standard asymptotics fail.
source_refs.author: Keisuke Hirano, Jack R. Porter

open_problems.why_unsolved: The available COT CLT is driven by smooth-density stability and quadratic transport, whereas this binary endpoint is estimated through a triangular array of marked cross-arm collisions. Kipnis supplies a close conditional-CLT and least-favorable-prior template, but its statistic is a one-sample occupancy functional and its parameter class is a distributional ball. The first proof step that changes is the LAN likelihood expansion under local flips of a deterministic sign shell, including the covariance among the score, collision count, and variance estimator. A Bayes lower bound under a supported mixture does not by itself imply the required deterministic-shell supremum: the prior must be conditioned or derandomized onto exact Hamming shells, with the local-radius limit taken before bounded quadratic-loss truncation is removed. Projection onto the global parameter range would also alter interior local risk, so the attaining procedure must remain unprojected.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A uniform LAN expansion on interior deterministic Hamming shells, a feasible variance estimator and studentized CLT for the raw collision estimator centered at L_K, a uniformly valid Gaussian interval, and matching local asymptotic minimax risks for bounded truncated quadratic losses with the radius and truncation limits explicitly ordered.

writing_exemplar.why: Follow its arc from a COT stability result to asymptotic normality and valid inference, while making the collision LAN calculation the replacement for density smoothness.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: COT inference needs a limit law -> smooth quadratic COT obtains one through functional stability -> sparse binary partitions instead concentrate information in many weak collisions -> derive their LAN experiment, studentization, and efficiency bound

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt the joint characteristic-function expansion for a weighted occupancy statistic and total count, the conditional lattice CLT, and the supported least-favorable-mixture likelihood ratio.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It provides the closest proof of Gaussian and sharp-minimax transfer from Poisson mixtures to fixed-size large-alphabet data; cross-arm marks and exact deterministic shells are the new components.

method_exemplars.technique: Reuse the uniform normal approximation for optimized histogram statistics and the sharp comparison of collision and denser regimes.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The lambda-divergent sparse regime likewise lies beyond a finite Poisson limit but below dense cellwise estimation and requires a sharp variance rather than only a rate.

method_exemplars.technique: Use convergence of local experiments and Bayes risk in the limit experiment to derive an attainable local asymptotic minimax bound under bounded losses.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired claim is an efficiency theorem obtained from a nonstandard local experiment; the new work is to validate that machinery uniformly on deterministic Hamming shells and order the limits correctly.

open_problems.open_problem: For n_0n_1/K converging to lambda in (0,infinity) with vanishing triple collisions, establish uniform two-way Le Cam equivalence between the legal deterministic two-arm sign-array experiment and a marked-Poisson collision experiment, and use it to characterize the exact asymptotic minimax absolute risk for L_K=a-b rho_K.

source_refs.claim: COT endpoints are causal partial-identification bounds, but finite-sample estimation is difficult because the COT functional is weak-topology discontinuous; the paper gives consistency and rates rather than a sparse finite-collision minimax experiment.
source_refs.author: Sirui Lin, Zijun Gao, Jose Blanchet, Peter Glynn

source_refs.claim: For large-alphabet Poisson data, a symmetric product prior yields a sharp minimax-risk analysis with collision-based behavior in the low-count regime.
source_refs.author: Alon Kipnis

source_refs.claim: A conditional CLT under a Poisson mixture prior transfers a sharp minimax lower bound from a Poissonized large-alphabet problem to the fixed-size multinomial experiment.
source_refs.author: Alon Kipnis

source_refs.claim: Chen-Stein dependency-neighborhood bounds control Poisson and Poisson-process approximation in total variation for locally dependent rare events.
source_refs.author: Richard Arratia, Larry Goldstein, Louis Gordon

open_problems.why_unsolved: Existing COT work proves consistency or rates for relaxed, discretized, or smooth-density estimators, while collision papers analyze testing functionals of one categorical law. Here the informative event is a cross-arm cell collision carrying an outcome mark, and uniformity is required over deterministic sign arrays. The forward Poisson approximation must retain the mark law, while a reverse kernel must synthesize noncollision observations without revealing armwise sign imbalance. Product-mixture and conditioning arguments are structurally close, but their first proof step must be replaced by a mixture supported on legal balanced arrays with fixed rho_K, followed by parameter-free reverse randomization. Searches over COT, Poissonization, collision testing, and large-alphabet minimax theory found no treatment of this marked two-sample COT endpoint experiment.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A theorem giving explicit parameter-free Markov kernels in both directions with deficiency tending to zero uniformly over legal arrays, followed by equality between the deterministic-array asymptotic minimax absolute risk for L_K and the computable minimax risk of the limiting marked-Poisson experiment.

writing_exemplar.why: Mirror its progression from the causal PI endpoint to the statistical instability of direct COT estimation, then introduce the finite-array collision regime as the missing local experiment.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Covariates sharpen causal PI bounds through COT -> direct estimation is unstable or slow in difficult regimes -> a growing finite partition reveals cross-arm information only through rare marked collisions -> characterize that collision experiment and its exact minimax information

method_exemplars.technique: Use Chen-Stein dependency neighborhoods to approximate the entire marked collision process in total variation, with explicit errors for overlapping collision indicators.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Cross-arm cell matches are locally dependent rare events; process-level total-variation control is the object needed for the forward Le Cam kernel.

method_exemplars.technique: Carry over the supported mixture-prior reduction, conditioning argument, and comparison of Poissonized and fixed-count likelihood ratios, replacing scalar occupancy marks by cross-arm outcome marks.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It proves sharp minimax transfer using a Poisson mixture prior and conditional limit theory; the new task changes the support constraint and mark likelihood while preserving the comparison architecture.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt explicit coincidence mean-variance calculations and sparse-alphabet lower-prior constructions to the cross-arm marked-collision statistic.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both problems concentrate usable information in collisions when samples are much fewer than cells, although the COT target is an estimand rather than a testing distance.

open_problems.open_problem: In the finite-lambda marked-Poisson collision experiment, characterize exact level-(1-alpha) confidence intervals for L=a-b rho that minimize worst-case expected length, and produce rigorously certified finite interval-action LP brackets whose coverage and optimality transfer uniformly to deterministic arrays.

source_refs.claim: The available asymptotically normal COT procedure uses smooth marginal densities and quadratic costs and does not cover exact finite-lambda inference for binary costs and discrete collision observations.
source_refs.author: Sirui Lin, Zijun Gao, Jose Blanchet, Peter Glynn

source_refs.claim: Uniform confidence intervals for interval-identified parameters require explicit treatment of boundary nuisance sequences; pointwise Gaussian reasoning can rely on an invalid local-superefficiency condition.
source_refs.author: Jorg Stoye

source_refs.claim: Minimax expected-measure confidence sets can be characterized through test inversion and Bayes-minimax duality under uniform coverage constraints.
source_refs.author: Steven N. Evans, Ben B. Hansen, Philip B. Stark

source_refs.claim: Optimization-defined partially identified parameters admit nonasymptotic procedures with finite-sample coverage guarantees, but the paper does not solve minimax expected length in a marked-Poisson experiment.
source_refs.author: Joel L. Horowitz, Sokbae Lee

open_problems.why_unsolved: In the marked-Poisson limit the observation space is countable and rho is continuous, so randomized interval actions make coverage and expected length linear and suggest an infinite LP. The concrete obstacle is certifying a finite discretization: count truncation requires a uniform Poisson-tail repair, parameter gridding requires an analytic off-grid coverage modulus, interval endpoints require an expansion argument that does not silently enlarge expected length, and primal-dual numerical gaps require directed-rounding enclosures. Evans, Hansen, and Stark supply decision-theoretic duality but not these Poisson and discretization certificates, while Stoye and smooth-COT inference are asymptotic Gaussian analyses rather than exact finite-lambda results.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A primal-dual characterization of honest minimax expected length, finite interval-action LPs with explicit tail and off-grid corrections yielding shrinking rational upper and lower brackets, and a theorem transferring both coverage and worst-case expected length to deterministic arrays through vanishing deficiency.

writing_exemplar.why: Use its inference-centered motivation for COT endpoints, but formulate finite-collision non-Gaussianity as the reason a different confidence procedure is needed.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: COT endpoints require uncertainty quantification -> available normal inference needs smooth densities and quadratic costs -> binary finite-array collisions have a discrete non-Gaussian limit -> solve the honest interval problem directly in that limit experiment

method_exemplars.technique: Translate randomized confidence sets into families of tests and use Bayes-minimax duality to express coverage and expected measure as linear functionals of the decision rule.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired interval LP has the same linear coverage-versus-expected-length structure, with a marked-Poisson likelihood replacing a restricted-location likelihood.

method_exemplars.technique: Carry over uniform-coverage analysis across boundary sequences, replacing Gaussian critical-value calibration by exact marked-Poisson coverage constraints.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It isolates why pointwise coverage arguments fail near changing identification boundaries, analogous to the endpoint and finite-lambda regimes here.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt optimization-based finite-sample coverage lower bounds, strengthened through exact enumeration, interval arithmetic, and primal-dual LP certificates.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both targets are optimization-defined causal bounds requiring a computational certificate that implies a coverage theorem.

open_problems.open_problem: For the declared continuous growing-roughness interpolation image of the finite sign arrays, derive an explicit partition-coarsening bias bound for the sharp binary-cost COT endpoint and combine it with collision uncertainty to obtain a uniformly honest resolution-adaptive interval and a minimax partition rule.

source_refs.claim: Covariate stratification sharpens causal bounds, but binning continuous or moderate-dimensional covariates can cause substantial efficiency loss and conditional-law estimation can invalidate inference under misspecification.
source_refs.author: Wenlong Ji, Lihua Lei, Asher Spector

source_refs.claim: A penalized relaxation produces bounds between unconditional OT and COT and becomes exact as its penalty diverges, exposing an approximation tradeoff.
source_refs.author: Sirui Lin, Zijun Gao, Jose Blanchet, Peter Glynn

source_refs.claim: The COT functional is discontinuous under weak convergence, and a partition-based direct estimator balances discretization resolution against observations per cell under a Lipschitz-kernel framework.
source_refs.author: Sirui Lin, Zijun Gao, Jose Blanchet, Peter Glynn

source_refs.claim: Wavelet estimation over Besov-smooth observable densities mitigates the COT curse of dimensionality and gives a quadratic-cost stability theorem and CLT.
source_refs.author: Sirui Lin, Zijun Gao, Jose Blanchet, Peter Glynn

open_problems.why_unsolved: The finite-array collision theorem targets the endpoint of the coarsened experiment, not automatically the endpoint under continuously varying covariates. This distinction is substantive because weak-topology discontinuity permits refinement or coarsening to change COT values. Ji, Lei, and Spector identify the inferential cost of binning, while the Lin, Gao, Blanchet, and Glynn estimators control approximation under fixed Lipschitz or Besov assumptions; none of the located papers gives a sharp bias-variance frontier when interpolation roughness grows with K for a binary nonsmooth cost. The first proof step must therefore precede any CLT: prove a deterministic comparison between the continuous conditional Bernoulli transport value and its K-cell projection using the declared interpolation modulus. Without that inequality, partition selection compares different endpoints rather than trading bias against variance.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A uniform inequality sup_{P in F_K}|V_COT(P)-L_K(P)|<=B_K for the stated growing-roughness interpolation class, sharp or rate-matching lower examples, and a level-(1-alpha) interval whose length decomposes into certified coarsening bias and collision uncertainty and attains the corresponding minimax resolution rate.

writing_exemplar.why: Mirror its framing of covariates as simultaneously tightening bounds and creating binning or nuisance-estimation hazards, then isolate partition resolution as an estimand-changing issue.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Covariates can sharply tighten partially identified causal effects -> continuous covariates force binning or conditional-law estimation -> binning can lose information and naive nuisance estimation can invalidate inference -> quantify when a partition preserves the COT endpoint and how finely it should be resolved

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt wavelet and Besov approximation bounds and COT stability, replacing quadratic-cost differentiability by a direct cellwise modulus bound for binary cost.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its smooth-density approximation controls the same conditional transport endpoint; the structural change is growing roughness and a nonsmooth Bernoulli transport value.

method_exemplars.technique: Carry over bias-aware honest confidence-interval construction over a convex smoothness class, selecting tuning parameters by worst-case bias and variance rather than undersmoothing.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Coarsening error is a deterministic worst-case bias and collision noise supplies the variance, matching the bias-aware honest-inference geometry.

method_exemplars.technique: Use explicit Le Cam-distance constructions over Besov classes to transfer procedures only where the interpolation class has sufficient regularity, and use the negative smoothness frontier to delimit the claim.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It shows that experiment transfer under Poissonization depends sharply on function-class regularity, precisely the issue raised by a growing-roughness continuous image.

literature_map:
1. Fan and Park (2010, Econometric Theory, doi:10.1017/S0266466609990168) derive sharp treatment-effect-distribution bounds and asymptotic inference, including covariate refinements, but not growing-cell collision regimes.
2. Ober-Reynolds (2023, arXiv:2311.09435) expresses sharp sets for moments of joint potential outcomes as OT values and uses directional differentiability and bootstrap inference for conventional finite-support settings.
3. Ji, Lei, and Spector (2023, arXiv:2310.08115) give uniformly valid dual COT inference around arbitrary nuisance fits and identify binning loss and conditional-law misspecification as central covariate-assisted hazards.
4. Lin, Gao, Blanchet, and Glynn (2025, ICML, arXiv:2502.01164) introduce a penalized covariate-aware OT relaxation interpolating between unconditional OT and exact COT.
5. Lin, Gao, Blanchet, and Glynn (2026, AISTATS, arXiv:2506.00257) prove adapted-Wasserstein continuity and partition-based consistency and rates, emphasizing weak-topology discontinuity of COT.
6. Lin, Gao, Blanchet, and Glynn (2026, arXiv:2602.20681) obtain wavelet rates and a COT CLT under smooth densities for quadratic cost; binary nonsmooth finite-array costs lie outside that result.
7. Gao, Ge, and Qian (2025, AISTATS, arXiv:2406.07868) prove exact multi-marginal OT partial identification and minimax plug-in rates for quadratic objectives, but do not resolve two-arm rare collisions.
8. Paninski (2008, IEEE TIT, doi:10.1109/TIT.2008.928987) establishes the sparse-alphabet collision threshold and explicit coincidence moments.
9. Arratia, Goldstein, and Gordon (1989, Annals of Probability, doi:10.1214/aop/1176991491) provide total-variation Poisson-process approximation for locally dependent rare events, the natural forward-kernel tool for collision marks.
10. Low and Zhou (2007, Annals of Statistics, arXiv:0708.2233) prove Poissonization equivalence above a regularity frontier and counterexamples below it, so continuous transfer must be class-restricted.
11. Kipnis (2026, IEEE TIT, doi:10.1109/TIT.2025.3646804) obtains sharp large-alphabet Poisson minimax risk via symmetric product priors, with collision behavior in the low-count regime.
12. Kipnis (2026, arXiv:2607.05223) closes the fixed-multinomial sharp lower bound using a conditional CLT under a Poisson mixture prior, supplying the closest supported-mixture transfer template.
13. Jiao, Venkat, Han, and Weissman (2015, IEEE TIT, arXiv:1406.6956) show that growing-alphabet nonsmooth functionals require dedicated minimax constructions rather than plug-in asymptotics.
14. Stoye (2009, Econometrica, doi:10.3982/ECTA7347), Evans, Hansen, and Stark (2005, Bernoulli, doi:10.3150/bj/1126126761), and Armstrong and Kolesar (2021, Econometrica, arXiv:1712.04594) supply uniform partial-ID coverage, minimax expected-length duality, and bias-aware honest inference.
15. The unoccupied combination is a binary COT endpoint whose information is carried by cross-arm marked collisions, with exact finite-lambda decisions, legal deterministic-array lower-experiment support, sparse Gaussian efficiency, and a separately proved coarsening bias for the declared continuous image.
